phase: Phase C Amendment 2: Independent Audit Remediation — Manufactured BVP Integrity, Executable Refusal Testing and Verification Contract Correctness
research_question: Can GDEC automatically produce useful, empirically reliable estimates of spatial discretisation uncertainty for supported engineering quantities of interest, while correctly identifying and refusing computations whose convergence evidence is inadequate?

H5a_empirical_uncertainty_coverage.definition: E_true = |J0 - J_exact| <= U0 evaluated strictly over issued contracts
H5a_empirical_uncertainty_coverage.sampling_model_note: Evaluated on pre-registered deterministic benchmark configurations; Clopper-Pearson interval describes Bernoulli parameter for the fixed benchmark generation family, not an IID sample of arbitrary CAD geometries.

H5b_claim_integrity.definition: Among configurations reporting estimated_target_met, E_true <= requested_tolerance

H6a_estimate_availability.definition: Fraction of eligible Tier 1 configurations receiving a verified uncertainty contract

H6b_estimate_sharpness.definition: R_U = U0 / E_true for cases where E_true > numerical_floor

H7_refusal_correctness.definition: Fraction of Tier 3 refusal cases returning the exact intended refusal status and priority code

H8_tier2_performance.definition: Availability and coverage on Tier 2 difficult and singular elasticity benchmarks
H8_tier2_performance.statistical_limitation: Sample size N=10 provides empirical screening on canonical singular benchmarks; does not constitute asymptotic population proof.
H8_tier2_performance.policy_on_failure: If Tier 2 fails either availability or coverage gate, contract scope is formally restricted: 'CONTRACT SCOPE RESTRICTED TO SMOOTH DISPLACEMENT QOIS ONLY'.

stop_condition: Freeze protocol and tag prereg-c-amendment-2. Declare AMENDMENT READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW. DO NOT execute confirmatory 40-configuration runs in this task.
